D5Digital

Quantizer

Every voltage lands in key

Rounds a control voltage to the nearest note of the selected scale. LFOs, random voltages and sequencers become melodies in key.

  • 12 scales on a rotary switch
  • Chord mode plays arpeggios
  • Trigger input latches notes in time
